hyperedges.note: All three are selectable via harvest(method=); iEPPA=algBCD, raking=IPF+Dykstra, lbfgsb=Deville-Sarndal dual
Six metrics × three rules form the pluggable convergence framework introduced in the convergence redesign spec
Three interdependent optimizations: cell deduplication reduces M_cell, prefactored products enable O(K·M_cell) per iter, linear dispatch avoids log/exp overhead at dense compression

hyperedges.label: Calibration solver suite: iEPPA + raking + sinkhorn + greg + chebyshev + grake share calib_linalg.cpp infrastructure
Convergence redesign: metric (6 values) x rule (3 values) orthogonal for all solvers
iEPPA acceleration: homotopy + greenkhorn + tang-eta compose to close 10x gap vs autumn
Convergence reform triad: pluggable criteria + SOR + best-iterate across all solvers
Three calibration solvers: iEPPA, raking, L-BFGS-B — all dispatched via harvest()
iEPPA+BCD framework for CMOT: iEPPA outer loop + dual BCD subsolver + CMOT problem structure together achieve provable convergence without small proximal parameter
GP-based algorithm selection system: GP emulator trained on iEPPA/raking/LBFGSB benchmark runs, uncertainty map, and K-stability validation jointly determine routing decision boundary
Tomography reconstruction evaluation: ground-truth images + PSNR metric + tomography projection operator together define the discrete tomography benchmark for iEPPA
